Read this dictionary entry for the word drive.

\n\ndrive \ˈdrīv\ verb
1. to take to another place by car
2. to guide the movement of
3. to force to go through
4. to throw hard or fast
\nWhich definition most closely fits the way the word drives is used in paragraph 1?
